review.notes: No code fences in the OCR, so no fence-swallowing. All four physical PDF pages were compared line-by-line against the OCR Markdown with a normalized word diff (case/punctuation-insensitive, LaTeX math collapsed), which surfaced exactly one content divergence; physical p.1 was rendered at 120 dpi (summary table crop at 320 dpi) and visually verified. The glued table cell 'availablehere' reproduces the printed 'available here' whose 'here' is a blue hyperlink, so the space loss is an OCR defect at the link-span boundary. The OCR string 'MAI-Image.2.6' inside the Model dependencies row reproduces a dot typo printed by the source PDF itself and is left unchanged. The mixed '\-' and '•' list markers match the repo's accepted model-card handling (sibling cards patched both directions), so bullet style was left as OCR produced it. Parameters '2 x 10^10', all dates, the 2,359,296 / 1536x1536 pixel figures and the 32K context length match the print.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.1 Model Summary table row prints 'Public data summary available here' with 'here' styled as a blue underlined hyperlink (visually verified at 320 dpi crop); the OCR dropped the space at the hyperlink span boundary and glued the words together.
